title: Running Guide
content: Running is a popular form of exercise. Beginners can improve their running performance through proper training, warmups and recovery.

title: Best Running Shoes
content: Running shoes provide cushioning and support for runners. Choosing the right running shoes can improve comfort and reduce injury risk.

title: Marathon Training
content: Marathon training requires a structured running schedule, endurance development, recovery and long-distance training.

title: Protein for Runners
content: Protein is important for muscle recovery after running and other forms of exercise. Runners should consume adequate protein as part of a balanced diet.
